productHunt.name: ShopTally Snap
productHunt.tagline: Snap a receipt and it's booked, for small shop owners
productHunt.description: A new feature of the ShopTally bookkeeping app: snap a paper receipt and the amount, date and vendor go into your books. Receipts are read on the phone, never uploaded.
productHunt.firstComment:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm Ji Bai, founder of ShopTally. We make a bookkeeping app for small shops: cafés, bookshops and florists run by one to three people.

The owners we talk to keep a drawer full of supplier receipts and spend an evening at month end typing them into a spreadsheet. Snap moves that to the moment the delivery comes: take a photo, and the amount, date and vendor go straight into the ShopTally books. Receipts are read on the phone, and the photos are never uploaded. It reads receipts in Chinese and English, and you can fix any entry; the original photo stays with it.

41 small shops used it for three weeks in our beta. Shen He, who owns Half Acre Books and had free Pro during the beta, put it this way: "Month end used to cost me an evening of typing up receipts. Now I snap them when the delivery comes."

The first 30 receipts each month are free; beyond 30, ShopTally Pro costs 18 yuan a month. Update the app to version 3.2 on iOS or Android to try it. We'd love to hear which receipts it struggles with.

A lot of people who run small shops spend an evening at month end typing a drawer full of supplier receipts into a spreadsheet.

Today ShopTally is launching Snap. When a delivery comes, take a photo of the paper receipt, and the amount, date and vendor go into the ShopTally books. Fix any entry at any time; the original photo stays with it.

One thing we cared about a lot: receipts are read on the phone, and the photos are never uploaded. A shop's supplier prices are its own business.

From October to November 2026, 41 small shops used it for three weeks in our beta. Shen He, owner of Half Acre Books, who had free Pro during the beta, told us: "Month end used to cost me an evening of typing up receipts. Now I snap them when the delivery comes."

The first 30 receipts each month are free; beyond 30, ShopTally Pro costs 18 yuan a month. Update the ShopTally app to version 3.2 to use it, on iOS and Android.

If you run a shop, or know someone who does, give it a try and tell us which receipts it still struggles with.

https://shoptally.example
